# Generated by tools/calibration_followup.py. Do not edit.
# Birth and death dates, with precision and rank, of the parties of the
# sampled contemporary statements (part 7). Precision 11 is a day, 10 a
# month, 9 a year, 8 a decade, 7 a century.
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT ?party ?kind ?time ?precision ?rank WHERE {
  VALUES ?party {
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q94738502>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q94741320>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q94745875>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q94757871>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q94848503>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q94937661>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q94990863>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q95190587>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q95803414>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q96483>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q9790>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q98475627>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q98545710>
    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q99198778>
  }
  { ?party p:P569 ?statement . ?statement psv:P569 ?value . BIND("birth" AS ?kind) }
  UNION
  { ?party p:P570 ?statement . ?statement psv:P570 ?value . BIND("death" AS ?kind) }
  ?value wikibase:timeValue ?time .
  ?value wikibase:timePrecision ?precision .
  ?statement wikibase:rank ?rank .
}
